0.5.note: H_N12 through H_N20 completed their bottom phase but later failed during TOP; H_N22/H_N24 failed during BOTTOM.

0.25.note: All quarter-rate families failed during BOTTOM at phase step 10.

interpretation: The frozen gentle bottom-first grid produced no complete nonbaseline endpoint, so no state pair was eligible for a fixed-Hc response test.
Reducing lower-boundary flux from 0.5*K0 to 0.25*K0 did not increase the admissible cumulative bottom transfer; the observed maximum decreased from about 0.03139 cm to 0.00706 cm.
Therefore the E03B/E03C construction limit is not supported as a simple monotone instantaneous-rate limit.
Further blind rate reduction along the same bottom-first route is not justified by the qualified evidence.

The half-rate families also show that cumulative bottom transfer alone is not sufficient to predict completion, because several families completed BOTTOM and failed only after forcing switched to TOP.
nonclaims: E03C does not establish H_c plus profile and root30 storage sufficiency.
E03C does not falsify deeper-profile memory.
The rate nonmonotonicity is specific to this strict research carrier and construction; it is not a production solver robustness claim.
No production coupling change is admitted.

next_step_basis.rationale: E03B and E03C show direction- and history-dependent admissibility rather than a monotone rate ceiling; the next state-sufficiency experiment should change the state observable or construction axis rather than continue scalar rate tuning.
